description: Validate a Peruvian RUC (11-digit tax ID) and look up the company in the public SUNAT registry file (Padrón Reducido del RUC). Returns check-digit validity, legal name, taxpayer status (active or not), fiscal-address condition (HABIDO / NO HABIDO), fiscal address with district, and a pass/review/fail vendor assessment with reasons. Full data is returned for company RUCs (prefix 20). For natural-person RUCs (prefix 10, 15, 16, 17) the taxpayer status and address condition are returned; the holder's name is returned only when the connector is used with an API key (?api_key=... or Authorization header), for supplier and customer verification; never the DNI or address (privacy, Ley 29733). If that copy is unavailable the answer is a check-digit validation with verification_level "format". Typical use: checking a Peruvian supplier or customer before paying, invoicing or onboarding it.

ruc.description: 11-digit Peru RUC, e.g. "20100047218". Spaces and dashes are ignored.
